200.description: The CANCELLED promise (also the replay and the repeat on an already cancelled promise).

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value "true", only when the response is the stored answer replayed for the same Idempotency-Key, method, path and body. The first execution never carries it.

orderId.description: Set when the order is placed (CONFIRMED).

groupNo.description: Set when the order is placed (CONFIRMED).

items.description: A line of a delivery offer or a promise, with the owner whose stock at the witness node covers it (ADR 0017). One owner covers the whole line; the units of several owners never add up.

ownerRef.description: The seller (sellerId) whose listing covers the line, chosen by the OwnerChoice rule. Optional and additive; omitted when the line is operator-owned.

items.title: PromisedLine

shipBy.description: Pickup cutoff at the witness node.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the delivery station serving the destination, the local calendar deliverByEarliest and deliverByLatest belong to. Always set on a new promise; omitted only for a promise stored before it was carried (ADR 0011), in which case read the window in UTC.

basis.description: Promise basis: SCHEDULED from the timetable, MEASURED when a leg's measured transit pushed the arrival later (ADR 0014), NOMINAL from lane times (STANDARD only).
basis.title: Basis

confidence.description: The calibrated probability, rounded to three decimals, that a quote is kept on time (ADR 0020): the share of the judged promises of its segment (tier, basis, node grade) whose lateness was within the buffer the quote carries. It is present only when the segment has at least minCalibrationObservations judgements in the window; absent means UNKNOWN, never zero, and consumers must read absence that way.
confidence.title: Confidence

witnessPath.description: The node, pickup departure, departure legs and delivery wave that prove feasibility. A NOMINAL path (STANDARD only) carries no departure or wave ids: pickupDepartureId and deliveryWaveId are omitted and legs is empty (E8).
witnessPath.title: WitnessPath

basis.title: Basis

It is present only when the segment has at least minCalibrationObservations judgements in the window; absent means UNKNOWN, never zero, and consumers must read absence that way.

deliveredAt.description: Present when the package was delivered; omitted for cause LOST or RETURNED.

400.description: The Idempotency-Key header is missing (idempotency-key-required) or malformed (idempotency-key-invalid), the request body is malformed (malformed-request, for bad JSON, an unknown field, trailing data, an empty body, a body over 64 KiB or a NUL character in the query or body), or a collection GET sent an undeclared query parameter (unknown-query-parameter), a bad limit (invalid-limit) or an undecodable cursor (invalid-cursor).

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value per logical request

404.description: Not found (not-found): the offer or promise does not exist; an identifier carrying a NUL character is resource-not-found.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).

409.description: State, capacity, closed or concurrency conflict (illegal-transition, concurrent-update, offer-not-quotable, promise-capacity-exhausted, book-closed, promise-hold-expired, promise-closed, revision-moves-earlier), or idempotency-key-reused when the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different method, path or body.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).

value.title: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request
value.detail: the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different method, path or body

500.description: Unexpected failure (internal-error); the detail never leaks the internal message. A 5xx is never stored for an Idempotency-Key, so the same key can retry.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).
